result.title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
result.comment: 25 pages, including references and supplementary material
result.summary: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 NexSight：用仅凭证据即可重建答案的验证流程，从 108 个长视频中筛选出 310 个证据可追溯的细粒度任务（SightLine），并配套统一的多尺度交互测试框架与任务轨迹级监督，用于评测和训练 agentic 长视频理解。
AI.relevance_reason: 其证据可追溯的验证设计、跨片段重新取证与防漏计检查，以及把求解轨迹转成观测决策监督，可供核查 LOOK 时机、证据筛选与 STOP 判定的收益和成本，但论文聚焦外部视频检索，未涉及内部 latent 状态。
